fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else (n * fact((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (fact(0) == 1)
  example (fact(2) == 2)
{
  if (n == 0) then 1 else (n * fact((n - 1)))
}

fn factorial(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == fact(n))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (factorial(0) == 0)
